info.name: Search for tours by different parameters such as a query or geographical coordinates.

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO 4217, The currency with which you would like to pay.

params.name: preformatted
params.description: The amount of content to deliver with the search results.

params.name: q
params.description: Mutually exclusive with 'coordinates' parameter! Query string, can be location name or IATA code. For IATA the query parameter looks like this: 'q=iata:jfk'

params.name: coordinates[]
params.description: Mutually exclusive with 'q' parameter! Search by latitude, longitude and radius passed as URL array.'

params.name: date[]
params.description: Check for tours that are offered on date or between dates.

params.name: cond_language[]
params.description: The conduction language(s) of a tour. When given, the results contain only tours that are available in the specified language(s).

params.name: price[]
params.description: Filter for price in the query.

params.name: categories[]
params.description: Filter for categories for a given query via 'q' or 'coordinates', also works stand-alone as the main query parameter.

params.name: rating[]
params.description: Filter for Tours with the given ratings. Single value min rating. Otherwise [min, max].

params.name: duration[]
params.description: Filter for min and/or max duration in minutes. Single Value max. duration. Otherwise [min, max].

params.name: flags[]
params.description: Various flags about properties of the tour (multiple selection allowed).

params.name: sortfield
params.description:
Defines the sort field. Behavior per value:
  - `popularity`: returns recommended results (an internal ranking, not raw popularity). `sortdirection` is ignored.
  - `rating`: ranks using internal signals in addition to `overall_rating`; results are not strictly ordered by the `overall_rating` response field alone.
  - `price`: sorts by price.
  - `duration`: sorts by duration.

params.name: sortdirection
params.description: Defines the sort order. Ignored when `sortfield=popularity`.
